verdict.rationale: Discord's developer platform lets you build bots that maintain persistent Gateway WebSocket connections, respond to events, and post via webhooks without a live user session — a viable path to background automations, but it requires building/hosting a custom bot rather than any built-in no-code 'automation' feature for end users, and there is no AI-specific automation framework or scheduling/trigger system documented. Missing for 10: native no-code automation builder, AI-agent-specific triggers/hooks, and independent evidence of bots actually running unattended long-term.
